main_measure.name: pooled mean next-bar return on forecast<0 bars minus all-bars mean
main_measure.threshold: at most -0.10% per day with stretch-clustered t <= -2; reject if >= 0

supporting_check.name: down-bar share in-state minus all bars (also: equity ends above flat, beats holding in-state)

decided_by: Inconclusive: the difference is negative but t > -2, or it is smaller than 0.10% per day, or the down-bar share is not higher inside the stretches.
reading: In-state bars are bars with forecast < 0 and stretches are their contiguous runs within one window (a run cut by a window edge counts once per window); the clustered SE treats the all-bars mean as fixed with a G/(G-1) correction; the confirm rule uses only the down-bar share from the supporting check, while the equity checks (pooled compounded before-cost gains) are reported in 'passed'.
